# Why aren't my YouTube chapters showing up?

> Free YouTube chapters checker: finds why chapters do not show (no 0:00 start, fewer than three, under 10 seconds, out of order), fixes the list, and converts Premiere, DaVinci Resolve (marker EDL) or Audacity markers to chapters, chapters.json, FFmetadata and WebVTT. Runs in your browser.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
